It usually carries ten additional troops, and packs two heavy blaster cannons. My repeater may bother it, but we don't have anything else with us that will even scratch its armor.|[[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]] and [[Vandro]]|<ref name="CM">{{WEGCite|story=Commando Mission|book=Heir to the Empire Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
The '''HAVr A9 Floating Fortress''' was a heavily-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] combat [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].

==Characteristics==
Produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]], the HAVr A9 Floating Fortress<ref name="ISB" /> was a 17.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]<ref name="ISB2" /> roughly cylindrical, heavily armored [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] combat vehicle.<ref name="ISB" /> Capable of reaching speeds of two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], with a maximum flight ceiling of twenty meters,<ref name="ISB2" /> the Floating Fortress was able to both avoid or go through most obstacles in its way.<ref name="ISB" />

The Floating Fortress mounted a twin turret [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] on its roof<ref name="ISB" /> comprised of two [[Mk 2e/W heavy blaster cannon]]s,<ref name="MBC" /> with each cannon capable of moving and tracking targets independently. At night, powerful search beams swept for targets before the blaster cannons locked on and fired.<ref name="ISB" />

A sophisticated audio-visual surveillance system was installed on the Floating Fortress, which combined [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] and [[Heat detector|heat sensing probes]] to create a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] bubble with a thirty-meter diameter. The resulting [[Target Identification Network]] could detect nearby enemies. The system was based off a sensor package employed by [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]. The TIN could also be used to target a single enemy for a surgical strike when a show of power was required that did not need wanton destruction.<ref name="ISB" />

Floating Fortresses required a crew of four; a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], a sensor operator for the Target Identification Network, and two [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]. There was room for ten [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to be carried aboard,<ref name="ISB" /> as well as one [[Metric ton/Legends|metric ton]] of cargo.<ref name="ISB2" />

==History==
[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Floating Fortress in action]]
The Floating Fortress gained a reputation for being a thorough, merciless vehicle in use by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Often deployed to combat uprisings in urban areas, entire [[City/Legends|cities]] could be devastated by a squad of Floating Fortresses in search of elements of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] or other enemies. Unlike the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], the Floating Fortress was capable of traversing the narrow streets of an urban environment, and still generated the fear and respect that its [[Walker/Legends|walker]] counterpart did. This led to a rivalry between the crews of Floating Fortresses and All Terrain Armored Transports. [[Army Command]] preferred deploying the walker in combat situations, while the commanders of the occupation forces preferred to utilize the Floating Fortress.<ref name="ISB" />

During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] gained a reputation for leading battles from the open hatch of a Floating Fortress.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> The prestigious [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]] utilized the Floating Fortress, among other vehicles, to train [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] cadets.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

The [[Katarn Commandos]] [[Mission to Hettsk|freed]] two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from a Floating Fortress on [[Hettsk]] around [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="CM" /> Several Floating Fortresses were also used by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the [[Assault on Yavin 4|attack on the Jedi Praxeum]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="DS">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>
